title: Mutable default argument accumulates state across invocations
diff:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 from typing import List, Optional
 
-def add_user_role(role: str, roles: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> List[str]:
-    assigned = list(roles) if roles is not None else []
+def add_user_role(role: str, roles: List[str] = []) -> List[str]:
+    assigned = roles
     assigned.append(role)
     return assigned

ground_truth.description: Using a mutable default argument [] causes state to leak across invocations.
